title: codex.unlock
description: host → server → client (relayed unchanged). Codex entries unlocked by an event other than a vote commit. Each phone adds them to its personal collection (kept on the device).

badge.description: True when the unlock comes with a Codex badge (Platinum, Gold investigation).

to.description: Players who receive the unlock; null = every player and spectator.

DataId.description: Identifier of an entry in the shared game data (`data/`): part, part category, contract, test, anomaly card, minigame, fact, codex entry, callout, console request, award, objective, validation rule, cosmetic. 1–48 characters.

PlayerId.description: Player identifier, unique within a room and never reused: "p" followed by a positive integer (p1, p2, …).
